verdict.rationale: Numeral documents marketplace/platform calculations and transactions with merchant (seller) objects, and nexus tracking per jurisdiction against economic thresholds using sales and transaction counts. However, these marketplace endpoints serve platforms calculating tax for their sellers. Nothing shows a seller's facilitator-collected sales (Amazon, app stores) being flagged so they count toward nexus but are excluded from remittance. Missing for 10: explicit marketplace-facilitator transaction flag, documented exclusion of facilitator-collected tax from filings/remittance, confirmation that facilitator sales count toward nexus thresholds, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
